name: nox-setup
title: Set up Nox-Lite
short: Set up or repair your private job-search workspace
description: Guide first-time Nox-Lite setup, resume an incomplete setup, or troubleshoot browser, tracker and email connections. Use when someone asks to get started or fix setup.
prompt: guide me through setup one step at a time.

name: nox-next-step
title: What should I do next
short: Choose a useful next step or finish your search
description: Review a Nox-Lite workspace when the user asks what to do next, feels stuck, wants to pause, or has found a job. Recommend the next action from recorded progress and decisions.
prompt: review my progress and recommend the next useful action.

name: nox-improve-profile
title: Improve my profile
short: Find gaps and build stronger career evidence
description: Audit career information, resolve conflicts, clarify job preferences, improve a general CV, or interview the user to strengthen their profile. Use for profile reviews, career uncertainty and new experience; use application preparation for a specific vacancy.
prompt: review my information and ask focused questions to improve it.

name: nox-find-jobs
title: Find suitable jobs
short: Find a small shortlist or a larger batch of jobs
description: Find jobs in the requested volume, from a small shortlist to a daily batch of 20–25, assess search coverage, or personalise platforms. Verify and deduplicate vacancies against the selected tracker; do not fill a quota with weak matches.
prompt: find verified jobs that suit me, using my saved search target.

name: nox-prepare-application
title: Prepare applications
short: Prepare one job or a batch, with a shared review
description: Assess a vacancy or prepare one or more selected applications with tailored CVs and exact form answers. For batch or bulk preparation, consolidate missing questions and present one linked review. Preparation is separate from submission.
prompt: prepare all the jobs I selected, group missing questions and show me the applications to review.

name: nox-submit-application
title: Submit approved applications
short: Submit a reviewed batch and resume unfinished jobs
description: Submit an approved application or batch, record each outcome, or resume an interrupted batch. Reuse applicable human approval and submission authority, continue past individual blockers and reconcile uncertain attempts before retrying.
prompt: submit the reviewed applications covered by my approval, and report each result or blocker.

name: nox-interview
title: Prepare for an interview
short: Research the role and rehearse supported answers
description: Prepare for a job interview, research a hiring team, practise interview answers or review an interview debrief. Use the exact submitted application and distinguish practice from employer assessments.
prompt: help me prepare for my interview and practise.

name: nox-email
title: Check application messages
short: Handle verification or reconcile hiring outcomes
description: Retrieve a code for an active authorized application or reconcile relevant application messages when requested, respecting the saved email-access choice. Never use this to bypass manual email mode or send messages without instruction.
prompt: help with application messages within my email preferences.

name: nox-schedule
title: Schedule my job search
short: Set up, inspect or pause recurring job-search work
description: Create, update, diagnose or pause a user-requested job-search schedule. Test manual work first and verify actual saved scheduling configuration and timezone.
prompt: help me set up a recurring search after testing it once.
